capabilities: Push modified notes with an IdNote frontmatter property to a GTC server over WebSocket
Execute server-sent commands on the vault (read, create, replace, move, open notes)
Create quick notes linked to server-side entries via ribbon, context menu, or command
Show connection state in the status bar and ribbon with auto-reconnect handling
Authenticate with a token and surface server error codes in modals
extras: Settings are stored in localStorage and explicitly not synchronized by Obsidian Sync; the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual-capable (English and French) and documents the full WebSocket protocol and loop-prevention behavior.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep vault notes in sync with entries in a GTC ERP system, so external records and local notes drift apart.

requires.name: GTC (ERP by Etudes Informatiques et Services)

summary: Synchronizes Obsidian notes with a GTC ERP server bidirectionally over an authenticated WebSocket connection.
